normalized_claims: For declarations from 2017 onward, period 6 is the annual consolidation.
The consolidated-data dictionary defines updated revenue forecast, realized revenue, updated expenditure appropriation, committed expenditure, liquidated expenditure and paid expenditure.
The consolidated-data dictionary separately defines the updated, committed, liquidated and paid education expenditure concepts.
limitations: The dictionary does not define the current OData aliases used by the 2025 Dados_Gerais_Siope response.
No NUM_POPU definition was located in this dictionary.
Annual consolidation is not itself evidence that later rectification is impossible.

normalized_claims: The official 2025 guide instructs municipalities to check annual transmission receipts and periods not yet sent.
The guide states a deadline of up to 30 days after the end of each bimester.
For the 2024 exercise, the guide identifies transmission and validation of sixth-bimester data as the exercise-end delivery due by 30 January 2025.
limitations: The guide does not state that a sixth-bimester declaration can never be rectified later.
The guide does not define the 2025 Dados_Gerais_Siope OData field aliases.

normalized_claims: The tutorial presents the declaration as potentially rectifying.
A rectifying sixth-bimester declaration requires authorization from the SIOPE technical team.
Rectifying declarations for bimesters one through five can be sent without that authorization.
limitations: This is a 2024 tutorial and does not by itself prove the observed 2025 declaration has reached a final non-rectifiable state.

normalized_claims: The current official downloads page lists municipal and state metadata packages for exercise 2025.
limitations: The linked 2025 metadata package contents were not available for inspection through the current documentary connector.
Existence of the package is not proof of the 11 alias meanings.

closure_summary.reason: Official documents prove the annual role of period 6 but also document a rectification path for sixth-bimester declarations.
